result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: it provides an uncapped Contractor defense and indemnity for third-party IP claims, legal violations, Contractor-caused data incidents, and gross negligence or willful misconduct; protects Company and its affiliates; includes standard notice, defense-control, settlement-consent, and cooperation procedures; and limits any Company indemnity to Company-provided materials and legal violations. The addition is appropriately confined to the missing indemnity and does not disturb the existing fee provision. Drafting is professional, though the data trigger could be slightly broader to cover data breaches involving loss, alteration, or destruction, not only unauthorized access or disclosure.
